Caveats & method
Era scale. RMSE is not comparable across eras — realized team-margin spread climbs from 4.44 to 5.24 — so correlation is the cross-era read.
Tuned era. The live model was tuned on 2021–2026, so seasons before that test the method rather than this fit.
Not independent of EPM. Our headline rating uses EPM as a prior, and the EPM-free version scores 12.477 against EPM's 12.362 — 0.1151 behind it.
Freshness. We re-rate every player every day while EPM and DARKO carry a value forward, a small edge we do not correct for.
Older seasons. Before 2014 the game set is incomplete and team-unbalanced, so era-level absolutes are affected even though every source is scored on identical games.
Coverage. A player with no rating that day is filled in at replacement level, so part of every team rating is imputed.
Vintage. Whether EPM and DARKO serve historical values as published then, or re-scored by today's model, is unresolved.
Training pool. Refitting the scale on all 24 seasons moves the gap to −0.0609, but 50% of that is the pool change, so the equal-information answer stays −0.0302.
No blend ships. The benchmark-only row shows what combining adds; it is not a product.

Built 2026-07-26. Every figure is re-read from its source and re-checked at build time; a drifted number fails the build instead of publishing.
